summary:
Starting pitcher ratings are the story to fade today — SP is cold across the board, with R1 bleeding out at 40% over the last 14 days (75-112, -9.4pts vs. baseline) and R3 not far behind at 44% (-6.6pts). All three rating models share this weakness since they're drawing from the same underlying pool, so any pick leaning heavily on SP grades deserves extra scrutiny regardless of which rating stamped it. On the flip side, bullpen is quietly the best category in the shop: all three ratings show identical HOT bullpen splits at 56% over 14 days (104-83, +5.1pts), making it the most reliable lever right now. R1's hitting category is also cooking at 56% (105-82, +6.5pts) while R2 and R3 hitting lag at a pedestrian 48% with active 4-game losing streaks — lean R1 for hitting-driven plays specifically. Watch R3's runs category too; it's 56% over 14 days but riding an 8-game losing streak, a classic case of a category that's still statistically hot short-term but bleeding value in real time.

On the strong-play side, R3 leads the pack — season P/L of +32.0u (131-115, 53%) and a positive 14-day window (+3.0u, 40-43, 48%), best combination of long-term edge and recent stability. R1's season number (+24.0u) is solid but its 7-day window just went negative (21-27, 44%, -1.0u), and R2 similarly cooled off in the last week (-1.0u) after a strong 14-day stretch (+2.0u). None of the three are lighting it up short-term, so size strong plays modestly today. For category combos, trends+runs remains the top agreement play at 55.6% (208-166, n=374), with trends+bullpen right behind at 54.7% — worth prioritizing when multiple ratings converge there. On teams, TBR is the standout when the model likes them strong (18-4, 82%, +23.0u) and LAD's strong-play record is even hotter on a rate basis (11-2, 85%, +14.0u) despite modest overall volume — target these two if today's slate features them. Fade HOU strong plays outright; the model likes them straight (15-10, 60%) but its strong convictions on HOU have been a disaster (2-7, 22%, -8.0u).
